### How these were measured

- Machine: Microsoft Surface Laptop 7 (Snapdragon X Elite X1E-80-100, 12 cores, 16 GB RAM, NVMe SSD), Windows 11 ARM64
- go1.27.2, windows/arm64, 12 logical CPUs, measured 2026-10-12
- Transport: net/rpc over TCP on 127.0.0.1, all nodes in one process
- Storage: one directory per node on the same disk, fsync on
- Workload: 50% Put, 50% Get, uniform keys, closed loop; 1000 keys, 64-byte values
- Each data point: 2s warm-up, then 8s measured
- Raft: election timeout 150-300 ms, heartbeat 50 ms, snapshot every 10000 entries
